Rules: start with 'flowchart TD' or 'flowchart LR'; solid arrows only (-->, optionally with |labels|); node shapes: A[Process] B{Decision} C([Start

tools.name: create_chevron_chart
tools.description: Create a sequential/chevron chart: a linear sequence of steps, phases, or stages (e.g. onboarding steps, project phases). NOT for branching logic — use create_flowchart for that. Include a 1-2 sentence description per step to make it presentation-ready. Aim for 4-6 steps: Presentation is one slide o

tools.name: create_funnel_chart
tools.description: Create a funnel chart for filtering/narrowing processes where quantities reduce per stage (conversion funnels, pipelines). Include stage values when numbers are available; set conversionRates for proportional widths.

tools.name: create_lifecycle_chart
tools.description: Create a lifecycle chart: phases across the top and milestones plotted on a curve. Each milestone has a level 1-10 setting its height — bell curves, S-curves, dips all emerge from levels. Use for product lifecycles, customer journeys, adoption/maturity curves. Every milestone needs a phaseId.

tools.name: create_timeline_chart
tools.description: Create a timeline of events in chronological order (roadmaps, company history, sprint/release schedules). tools.name: create_erd_chart
tools.description: Create an entity-relationship diagram (database schema / data model) with typed fields, PK/FK markers, and crow's-foot relationships. Entity names UPPER_SNAKE_CASE, 3-8 focused fields each.

tools.name: edit_chart
tools.description: Edit an existing chart. Call get_chart first to see its current spec, then pass tool_calls (surgical edits) and/or mermaid (full source replacement, flowchart/ERD only). A create_* tool call replaces the chart's data wholesale and can switch its type. Valid tool names — flowchart: style_chart, updat

tools.name: get_chart
tools.description: Fetch a chart's current spec (JSON) and editable source text, plus its share URL.

tools.name: list_charts
tools.description: List your CalderFlow charts (id, title, type, share URL), newest first.

tools.name: delete_chart
tools.description: Permanently delete a chart you own.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "edit_chart" is 2468 chars, far longer than this server's median (255). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_chart, list_charts · Private data: create_erd_chart · Public sink: create_flowchart, get_chart, list_charts · Destructive: edit_chart, delete_chart.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_chart, list_charts · Private data: create_erd_chart · Public sink: create_flowchart, get_chart, list_charts · Destructive: edit_chart, delete_chart

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
